column2: The fingerprinting surface the anti-fingerprinting shim (lib/js/anti_fingerprinting.js) answers for, and the known gaps it does not.
One row per surface. `token` is the property/method name as the shim patches it (the join key the completeness gate uses);
a media-query feature has no property token, so it carries an `@mq:<feature>` token the extractor never matches.
Columns: token  group  api  status  mode  worker  spec  notes
status: covered = the shim patches it; open = a known surface the shim does not touch yet; the gate holds `covered` == what the shim patches.
mode: normalize (one value for every site), randomize (seeded per siteId), empty (removed), passthrough (left as the engine's), suppress (event dropped).
worker: yes = also patched in worker scope (worker_shim); no = window-only; - = n/a.
Gate: test/js/fingerprint_surface_catalog.test.js (rung 5: source text; no type says a JS patch is catalogued).
